thread:
Alex M.: starting the role_hierarchy v2 migration now, rolling through 10% of orgs. will monitor audit logs.
Maria G.: saw a weird spike in denied reads on the metrics dashboard, any relation?
Alex M.: yep — looks correlated with the migration window, some serialized role blobs failed to parse after KMS rotation.
Chris L.: wtf. which rotation? the auto-kms-rotation from last night?
Alex M.: yes. root cause: we store signed role blobs and verify with old key id during backfill; rotation changed key metadata ordering so our deserializer treats it as unknown.
Maria G.: can you paste the failing payload and the parser error?
Alex M.: here's the stack and sample blob:
```
ERROR: RoleDeserializer: invalid_key_id: expected "kms://keys/rdw-01", got "kms://keys/01-rdw"
payload: {"roles": [{"id":"eng_view","inherits":["infra_read"]}], "sig_v":"1"}
stack: com.redwood.security.RoleDeserializer.parse(RoleDeserializer.java:87)
```
Chris L.: ok that explains it — string-based comparison of key id vs canonical KMS ARN. parser should normalize. quick fix: tolerant lookup that checks suffix.
Jamie (oncall): current impact? do services fall back to default role or deny by default?
Alex M.: deny by default. we saw ~120 denied tokens in the last 15m, mostly CI and a couple SRE dashboards.
sec-bot: Incident detected: RBAC anomalies (deny spike) — runbook suggested: throttle migration, add tolerant parser, and trigger reconciliation job.
Maria G.: I'm going to pause the migration at 10% and open a canary rollback if needed.
Chris L.: patch ready (small change) — PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/roles/pulls/452
Chris L.: diff summary: RoleDeserializer now canonicalizes key id using regex and falls back to KMS metadata lookup if mismatch.
Alex M.: can we ship hotfix to dedicated runtime first (small pool) before Hosted? prefer low blast radius.
Jamie (oncall): deploying hotfix to dedicated now. will watch for rejections clearing.
sec-bot: Deploy started: roles-service hotfix v1.2.1-canary on dedicated cluster.
Maria G.: also adding an audit-only migration to detect blobs that would break (no mutation). job scheduled.
Alex M.: action items: (1) hold full rollout, (2) merge hotfix + ship canary, (3) run detection job, (4) plan full reconciliation to reprocess affected blobs with normalized keys.
Chris L.: ETA for canary result ~15m. if green we promote and resume at 2% increments.
Jamie (oncall): will alert SRE channels if denials > 300/min. ping me @Jamie.
Alex M.: thanks team. logging follow-up: add more context to audit events: original_key_id, resolved_key_arn, and migration_tag.
Maria G.: I'll own the reconciliation job and add a dry-run mode first.
Alex M.: closing loop — record in incident tracker and notify security review for KMS rotation handling.
